body: Backlog follow-up (2026-09-28): verified the five burndown-ready specs (TASK-1537, STORY-1484, STORY-1498, STORY-1500, TASK-1545) still have no persisted execution_mode in their canonical YAML, so product cannot dispatch them through `aida do` without your mode decision.
